text_block_list.text:
One holiday.
While out shopping with Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haa... What should I do? I came all this way, but at this rate, it's all for nothing...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy!
Flower, is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-It's really nothing that big.
I'm just agonizing over what clothes to buy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Then let's walk around together! It's so much fun
exploring new fashion with someone else☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can enjoy... new fashion...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um! I'm so grateful!
I'd love to join you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! "Diamond Shoes"!?
So sparkly and wonderful! Let's try them on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A diamond!?
I could never try on something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ta-dah☆ This wetsuit is so cool!
Wear it on a rainy day and you'll be invincible, yes!☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hawawa! Diving gear out in the middle of town!? Th-That's way too bold~~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hum hum humm♪
What outfit shall we try next~♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Taiki-senpai is amazing, isn't she?
She's so... powerful...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No!
I'm just so deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, um... I came to buy clothes today.
...Clothes that make me look like a grown-up."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But when I look at the clothes in the shops,
I feel like they wouldn't suit me... and I lose the courage to wear them...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Taiki-senpai is so amazing!
She can pull off any outfit so effortlessly.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Good? Non, non!
The secret to this coordination is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's a heart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I dressed up in this outfit so we could have
an active and happy outingâª

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What does your heart desire, Flower?
What kind of outfit do you want, and what kind of mood do you want to be in, yes?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: My mood... what I'm feeling is—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to become a big sister who is kind and brings smiles to everyone... just like a cosmos flower!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Graaaate! That's right!
Yes, that spirit is what matters!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Those are the clothes you truly want to wear, the ones you should buy.
I'm sure they'll look wonderful on you~♪"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! Yes!
...I'm going to take another look around the shops!

Along with Taiki Shuttle, I watched as she
ran off with a bright smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since we went through the trouble of coming shopping,
it'd be a total loss if we didn't enjoy it♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: By the waaaay~... there's someone right here who hasn't bought anything yet, no!?
choice_data_list: Maybe I should buy some new clothes!
Actually, money's been a bit tight this month...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Roger that! That's the spirit☆
Now, let's ask your heart right away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! What kind of mood were you in
when you went out today desu ka?
choice_data_list: Just like you, I was looking forward to it.
Just like you, I was looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just like mine?! We share the same heart...!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Matching clothes... You want to wear matching outfits with me, YES!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! We can add even more frills to the sleeves, DESU YO!
And there were pants with a cute heart pattern, MASITA!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Time to GO try it on right now--!!
Still laboring under the misunderstanding, she ran off to buy clothes, leaving me chasing frantically after her...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... In that case,
let me treat you as thanks for joining me today!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry.
This card has already reached its limit...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer and I are both flat broke! And sharing the same broken heart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, why are you apologizing?
Trainer, I'm super happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because our hearts are one.
It means our hearts are matching outfits... desu kara♪
Afterward, they headed back to the academy together on good terms, chatting about everything that had happened that day.
